				<script>
		(function(){
			const showDebugOutput = false;
			const cacheTTL = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000; // 24 hours
			let expiryTimeoutId = null;
			let formRefreshTimeoutId = null;
			let fetchInFlight = false;
			const identityEnabled = true;

			// A record with hiding off is never selected, even when another record uses
			// the same opt-in ID. Missing mappings stay visible and require no identity call.
			function subscriberPlacements() {
				return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-newsletter-placement][data-newsletter-hide="1"]'))
					.filter(root => !!root.dataset.subscriptionKey);
			}

			function hasRequiredProperties(data) {
				if (!data) return false;
				if (data.known === false) return true;
				if (data.known !== true) return false;
				const subs = data.subscriptions || {};
				return subscriberPlacements().every(root => Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(subs, root.dataset.subscriptionKey));
			}

			function needsIdentity() {
				return identityEnabled && (showDebugOutput || subscriberPlacements().length > 0);
			}

			function logDebug(...args) {
				if (showDebugOutput) console.log('[HubSpot Debug]', ...args);
			}

			function getCookie(name) {
				const match = document.cookie.match(new RegExp('(^| )' + name + '=([^;]+)'));
				return match ? match[2] : null;
			}

			function setHubspotField() {
				const token = getCookie('hubspotutk');
				if (!token) return;
				document.querySelectorAll('input[name="hubspotutk"]').forEach(function(input){
					input.value = token;
				});
			}

			function showStatus(data) {
				if (!showDebugOutput) return;
				const wrapper = document.getElementById('cap-hubspot-status');
				if (!wrapper) return;
				wrapper.style = 'padding:1em; background:#fff; border-top:1px solid #ccc; font-size:14px; z-index:9999; white-space:pre-wrap;';
				if (!data.known) {
					wrapper.textContent = 'Admin-only status: No matching HubSpot contact found for this visitor. The cookie may not yet be linked to a contact.';
					return;
				}
				// Identity API strings are text, never trusted HTML, even in editor debug UI.
				wrapper.textContent = [
					'Admin-only status: Known contact found.',
					'Email: ' + String(data.email || '(no email)'),
					'Name: ' + String(data.name || '(not set)'),
					'Subscriptions:',
					...Object.entries(data.subscriptions || {}).map(([key, value]) => String(key) + ': ' + String(value))
				].join('\n');
			}

			function showNoCookieMessage() {
				if (!showDebugOutput) return;
				const wrapper = document.getElementById('cap-hubspot-status');
				if (!wrapper) return;
				wrapper.textContent = 'Admin-only status: No HubSpot cookie detected. HubSpot may be blocked by the browser or not yet set.';
			}

			function scheduleCacheExpiry(cacheKey, delay) {
				if (expiryTimeoutId !== null) {
					clearTimeout(expiryTimeoutId);
				}
				expiryTimeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
					logDebug('Auto-expiring cache for', cacheKey);
					localStorage.removeItem(cacheKey);
					fetchHubspotStatus();
				}, delay);
			}

			async function fetchHubspotStatus(force = false) {
				if (!needsIdentity()) return;
				const utk = getCookie('hubspotutk');
				logDebug('hubspotutk value:', utk);

				// If there's no UTK cookie, show a “blocked/no cookie” message and bail out
				if (!utk) {
					showNoCookieMessage();
					return;
				}

				const cacheKey = 'hubspot-newsletter-status-v1-' + utk;

				if (!force) {
					const cached = localStorage.getItem(cacheKey);
					if (cached) {
						try {
							const parsed = JSON.parse(cached);
							const age = Date.now() - parsed.timestamp;
							if (age >= 0 && age < cacheTTL && hasRequiredProperties(parsed.data)) {
								logDebug('Using cached value for', cacheKey);
								showStatus(parsed.data);
								conditionallyHideForms(parsed.data);

								// Schedule expiry of the remaining TTL
								const remaining = cacheTTL - age;
								scheduleCacheExpiry(cacheKey, remaining);
								return;
							} else {
								logDebug('Cache expired for', cacheKey);
								localStorage.removeItem(cacheKey);
							}
						} catch (e) {
							logDebug('Invalid cached value:', e);
							localStorage.removeItem(cacheKey);
						}
					}
				}

				// Every eligible placement shares this request/cache; overlapping events do not fan out.
				if (fetchInFlight) return;
				fetchInFlight = true;
				logDebug('No valid cache found or force=true, fetching from API...');

				try {
					const res = await fetch('https://www.americanprogress.org/wp-json/cap/v1/hubspot-identity?utk=' + encodeURIComponent(utk));
					if (!res.ok) {
						logDebug('Fetch returned non-OK status:', res.status);
						return;
					}
					const fullData = await res.json();
					logDebug('API response:', fullData);

					const { known, email, name, subscriptions } = fullData;
					const dataToCache = { known, email, name, subscriptions };

					// A newly configured property must not be treated as verified false
					// merely because an older cached response omitted it.
					if (hasRequiredProperties(dataToCache)) {
						localStorage.setItem(cacheKey, JSON.stringify({ timestamp: Date.now(), data: dataToCache }));
					} else {
						localStorage.removeItem(cacheKey);
					}

					showStatus(fullData);
					conditionallyHideForms(dataToCache);

					// Schedule a fresh expiry 24h from now
					scheduleCacheExpiry(cacheKey, cacheTTL);
				} catch (err) {
					logDebug('Fetch error:', err);
				} finally {
					fetchInFlight = false;
				}
			}

			function conditionallyHideForms(data) {
				const subs = data.subscriptions || {};
				subscriberPlacements().forEach(root => {
					const value = String(subs[root.dataset.subscriptionKey] || 'false').toLowerCase();
					const subscribed = value === 'true' || value === 'subscribed';
					const slideup = root.querySelector('.signup2');
					const formPane = slideup ? slideup.querySelector('.signup2-form') : null;
					const altPane = slideup ? slideup.querySelector('.signup2-alt') : null;
					const replace = !!(slideup && slideup.hasAttribute('data-slideup-alt') && altPane);
					// A component's optional message is a sibling of this form root. Its
					// nearest component wrapper is the ownership boundary; never search the page.
					const component = root.closest('[data-newsletter-component]');
					const message = component ? component.querySelector('.-hubspot-subscriber-message') : null;
					root.style.display = subscribed && !replace ? 'none' : '';
					if (formPane) formPane.style.display = subscribed ? 'none' : '';
					if (altPane) altPane.style.display = subscribed && replace ? '' : 'none';
					if (message) message.style.display = subscribed && !replace ? '' : 'none';

				<script>
		(function(){
			const showDebugOutput = false;
			const cacheTTL = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000; // 24 hours
			let expiryTimeoutId = null;
			let formRefreshTimeoutId = null;
			let fetchInFlight = false;
			const identityEnabled = true;

			// A record with hiding off is never selected, even when another record uses
			// the same opt-in ID. Missing mappings stay visible and require no identity call.
			function subscriberPlacements() {
				return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-newsletter-placement][data-newsletter-hide="1"]'))
					.filter(root => !!root.dataset.subscriptionKey);
			}

			function hasRequiredProperties(data) {
				if (!data) return false;
				if (data.known === false) return true;
				if (data.known !== true) return false;
				const subs = data.subscriptions || {};
				return subscriberPlacements().every(root => Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(subs, root.dataset.subscriptionKey));
			}

			function needsIdentity() {
				return identityEnabled && (showDebugOutput || subscriberPlacements().length > 0);
			}

			function logDebug(...args) {
				if (showDebugOutput) console.log('[HubSpot Debug]', ...args);
			}

			function getCookie(name) {
				const match = document.cookie.match(new RegExp('(^| )' + name + '=([^;]+)'));
				return match ? match[2] : null;
			}

			function setHubspotField() {
				const token = getCookie('hubspotutk');
				if (!token) return;
				document.querySelectorAll('input[name="hubspotutk"]').forEach(function(input){
					input.value = token;
				});
			}

			function showStatus(data) {
				if (!showDebugOutput) return;
				const wrapper = document.getElementById('cap-hubspot-status');
				if (!wrapper) return;
				wrapper.style = 'padding:1em; background:#fff; border-top:1px solid #ccc; font-size:14px; z-index:9999; white-space:pre-wrap;';
				if (!data.known) {
					wrapper.textContent = 'Admin-only status: No matching HubSpot contact found for this visitor. The cookie may not yet be linked to a contact.';
					return;
				}
				// Identity API strings are text, never trusted HTML, even in editor debug UI.
				wrapper.textContent = [
					'Admin-only status: Known contact found.',
					'Email: ' + String(data.email || '(no email)'),
					'Name: ' + String(data.name || '(not set)'),
					'Subscriptions:',
					...Object.entries(data.subscriptions || {}).map(([key, value]) => String(key) + ': ' + String(value))
				].join('\n');
			}

			function showNoCookieMessage() {
				if (!showDebugOutput) return;
				const wrapper = document.getElementById('cap-hubspot-status');
				if (!wrapper) return;
				wrapper.textContent = 'Admin-only status: No HubSpot cookie detected. HubSpot may be blocked by the browser or not yet set.';
			}

			function scheduleCacheExpiry(cacheKey, delay) {
				if (expiryTimeoutId !== null) {
					clearTimeout(expiryTimeoutId);
				}
				expiryTimeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
					logDebug('Auto-expiring cache for', cacheKey);
					localStorage.removeItem(cacheKey);
					fetchHubspotStatus();
				}, delay);
			}

			async function fetchHubspotStatus(force = false) {
				if (!needsIdentity()) return;
				const utk = getCookie('hubspotutk');
				logDebug('hubspotutk value:', utk);

				// If there's no UTK cookie, show a “blocked/no cookie” message and bail out
				if (!utk) {
					showNoCookieMessage();
					return;
				}

				const cacheKey = 'hubspot-newsletter-status-v1-' + utk;

				if (!force) {
					const cached = localStorage.getItem(cacheKey);
					if (cached) {
						try {
							const parsed = JSON.parse(cached);
							const age = Date.now() - parsed.timestamp;
							if (age >= 0 && age < cacheTTL && hasRequiredProperties(parsed.data)) {
								logDebug('Using cached value for', cacheKey);
								showStatus(parsed.data);
								conditionallyHideForms(parsed.data);

								// Schedule expiry of the remaining TTL
								const remaining = cacheTTL - age;
								scheduleCacheExpiry(cacheKey, remaining);
								return;
							} else {
								logDebug('Cache expired for', cacheKey);
								localStorage.removeItem(cacheKey);
							}
						} catch (e) {
							logDebug('Invalid cached value:', e);
							localStorage.removeItem(cacheKey);
						}
					}
				}

				// Every eligible placement shares this request/cache; overlapping events do not fan out.
				if (fetchInFlight) return;
				fetchInFlight = true;
				logDebug('No valid cache found or force=true, fetching from API...');

				try {
					const res = await fetch('https://www.americanprogress.org/wp-json/cap/v1/hubspot-identity?utk=' + encodeURIComponent(utk));
					if (!res.ok) {
						logDebug('Fetch returned non-OK status:', res.status);
						return;
					}
					const fullData = await res.json();
					logDebug('API response:', fullData);

					const { known, email, name, subscriptions } = fullData;
					const dataToCache = { known, email, name, subscriptions };

					// A newly configured property must not be treated as verified false
					// merely because an older cached response omitted it.
					if (hasRequiredProperties(dataToCache)) {
						localStorage.setItem(cacheKey, JSON.stringify({ timestamp: Date.now(), data: dataToCache }));
					} else {
						localStorage.removeItem(cacheKey);
					}

					showStatus(fullData);
					conditionallyHideForms(dataToCache);

					// Schedule a fresh expiry 24h from now
					scheduleCacheExpiry(cacheKey, cacheTTL);
				} catch (err) {
					logDebug('Fetch error:', err);
				} finally {
					fetchInFlight = false;
				}
			}

			function conditionallyHideForms(data) {
				const subs = data.subscriptions || {};
				subscriberPlacements().forEach(root => {
					const value = String(subs[root.dataset.subscriptionKey] || 'false').toLowerCase();
					const subscribed = value === 'true' || value === 'subscribed';
					const slideup = root.querySelector('.signup2');
					const formPane = slideup ? slideup.querySelector('.signup2-form') : null;
					const altPane = slideup ? slideup.querySelector('.signup2-alt') : null;
					const replace = !!(slideup && slideup.hasAttribute('data-slideup-alt') && altPane);
					// A component's optional message is a sibling of this form root. Its
					// nearest component wrapper is the ownership boundary; never search the page.
					const component = root.closest('[data-newsletter-component]');
					const message = component ? component.querySelector('.-hubspot-subscriber-message') : null;
					root.style.display = subscribed && !replace ? 'none' : '';
					if (formPane) formPane.style.display = subscribed ? 'none' : '';
					if (altPane) altPane.style.display = subscribed && replace ? '' : 'none';
					if (message) message.style.display = subscribed && !replace ? '' : 'none';
				});
			}

			document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
				setHubspotField();
				fetchHubspotStatus();
			});

			document.addEventListener('gform_post_render', function(event) {
				setHubspotField();
				if (!needsIdentity()) return;
				const utk = getCookie('hubspotutk');
				if (utk) {
					const cacheKey = 'hubspot-newsletter-status-v1-' + utk;
					logDebug('Form revealed; scheduling cache clear in 3 minutes for', cacheKey);
					clearTimeout(formRefreshTimeoutId);
					formRefreshTimeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
						logDebug('Clearing cache after 3-minute delay (Gravity Form revealed)');
						localStorage.removeItem(cacheKey);
						fetchHubspotStatus(true);
					}, 3 * 60 * 1000); // 3 minutes
				} else {
					// If no cookie even after form appears, remind admin it may be blocked
					showNoCookieMessage();
				}
			});

			window.CAP_HubSpot_DebugRefetch = function() {
				logDebug('Forcing re-fetch from HubSpot API');
				fetchHubspotStatus(true);
			};

		})();
		</script>

				<script>
		(function(){
			const showDebugOutput = false;
			const cacheTTL = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000; // 24 hours
			let expiryTimeoutId = null;
			let formRefreshTimeoutId = null;
			let fetchInFlight = false;
			const identityEnabled = true;

			// A record with hiding off is never selected, even when another record uses
			// the same opt-in ID. Missing mappings stay visible and require no identity call.
			function subscriberPlacements() {
				return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-newsletter-placement][data-newsletter-hide="1"]'))
					.filter(root => !!root.dataset.subscriptionKey);
			}

			function hasRequiredProperties(data) {
				if (!data) return false;
				if (data.known === false) return true;
				if (data.known !== true) return false;
				const subs = data.subscriptions || {};
				return subscriberPlacements().every(root => Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(subs, root.dataset.subscriptionKey));
			}

			function needsIdentity() {
				return identityEnabled && (showDebugOutput || subscriberPlacements().length > 0);
			}

			function logDebug(...args) {
				if (showDebugOutput) console.log('[HubSpot Debug]', ...args);
			}

			function getCookie(name) {
				const match = document.cookie.match(new RegExp('(^| )' + name + '=([^;]+)'));
				return match ? match[2] : null;
			}

			function setHubspotField() {
				const token = getCookie('hubspotutk');
				if (!token) return;
				document.querySelectorAll('input[name="hubspotutk"]').forEach(function(input){
					input.value = token;
				});
			}

			function showStatus(data) {
				if (!showDebugOutput) return;
				const wrapper = document.getElementById('cap-hubspot-status');
				if (!wrapper) return;
				wrapper.style = 'padding:1em; background:#fff; border-top:1px solid #ccc; font-size:14px; z-index:9999; white-space:pre-wrap;';
				if (!data.known) {
					wrapper.textContent = 'Admin-only status: No matching HubSpot contact found for this visitor. The cookie may not yet be linked to a contact.';
					return;
				}
				// Identity API strings are text, never trusted HTML, even in editor debug UI.
				wrapper.textContent = [
					'Admin-only status: Known contact found.',
					'Email: ' + String(data.email || '(no email)'),
					'Name: ' + String(data.name || '(not set)'),
					'Subscriptions:',
					...Object.entries(data.subscriptions || {}).map(([key, value]) => String(key) + ': ' + String(value))
				].join('\n');
			}

			function showNoCookieMessage() {
				if (!showDebugOutput) return;
				const wrapper = document.getElementById('cap-hubspot-status');
				if (!wrapper) return;
				wrapper.textContent = 'Admin-only status: No HubSpot cookie detected. HubSpot may be blocked by the browser or not yet set.';
			}

			function scheduleCacheExpiry(cacheKey, delay) {
				if (expiryTimeoutId !== null) {
					clearTimeout(expiryTimeoutId);
				}
				expiryTimeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
					logDebug('Auto-expiring cache for', cacheKey);
					localStorage.removeItem(cacheKey);
					fetchHubspotStatus();
				}, delay);
			}

			async function fetchHubspotStatus(force = false) {
				if (!needsIdentity()) return;
				const utk = getCookie('hubspotutk');
				logDebug('hubspotutk value:', utk);

				// If there's no UTK cookie, show a “blocked/no cookie” message and bail out
				if (!utk) {
					showNoCookieMessage();
					return;
				}

				const cacheKey = 'hubspot-newsletter-status-v1-' + utk;

				if (!force) {
					const cached = localStorage.getItem(cacheKey);
					if (cached) {
						try {
							const parsed = JSON.parse(cached);
							const age = Date.now() - parsed.timestamp;
							if (age >= 0 && age < cacheTTL && hasRequiredProperties(parsed.data)) {
								logDebug('Using cached value for', cacheKey);
								showStatus(parsed.data);
								conditionallyHideForms(parsed.data);

								// Schedule expiry of the remaining TTL
								const remaining = cacheTTL - age;
								scheduleCacheExpiry(cacheKey, remaining);
								return;
							} else {
								logDebug('Cache expired for', cacheKey);
								localStorage.removeItem(cacheKey);
							}
						} catch (e) {
							logDebug('Invalid cached value:', e);
							localStorage.removeItem(cacheKey);
						}
					}
				}

				// Every eligible placement shares this request/cache; overlapping events do not fan out.
				if (fetchInFlight) return;
				fetchInFlight = true;
				logDebug('No valid cache found or force=true, fetching from API...');

				try {
					const res = await fetch('https://www.americanprogress.org/wp-json/cap/v1/hubspot-identity?utk=' + encodeURIComponent(utk));
					if (!res.ok) {
						logDebug('Fetch returned non-OK status:', res.status);
						return;
					}
					const fullData = await res.json();
					logDebug('API response:', fullData);

					const { known, email, name, subscriptions } = fullData;
					const dataToCache = { known, email, name, subscriptions };

					// A newly configured property must not be treated as verified false
					// merely because an older cached response omitted it.
					if (hasRequiredProperties(dataToCache)) {
						localStorage.setItem(cacheKey, JSON.stringify({ timestamp: Date.now(), data: dataToCache }));
					} else {
						localStorage.removeItem(cacheKey);
					}

					showStatus(fullData);
					conditionallyHideForms(dataToCache);

					// Schedule a fresh expiry 24h from now
					scheduleCacheExpiry(cacheKey, cacheTTL);
				} catch (err) {
					logDebug('Fetch error:', err);
				} finally {
					fetchInFlight = false;
				}
			}

			function conditionallyHideForms(data) {
				const subs = data.subscriptions || {};
				subscriberPlacements().forEach(root => {
					const value = String(subs[root.dataset.subscriptionKey] || 'false').toLowerCase();
					const subscribed = value === 'true' || value === 'subscribed';
					const slideup = root.querySelector('.signup2');
					const formPane = slideup ? slideup.querySelector('.signup2-form') : null;
					const altPane = slideup ? slideup.querySelector('.signup2-alt') : null;
					const replace = !!(slideup && slideup.hasAttribute('data-slideup-alt') && altPane);
					// A component's optional message is a sibling of this form root. Its
					// nearest component wrapper is the ownership boundary; never search the page.
					const component = root.closest('[data-newsletter-component]');
					const message = component ? component.querySelector('.-hubspot-subscriber-message') : null;
					root.style.display = subscribed && !replace ? 'none' : '';
					if (formPane) formPane.style.display = subscribed ? 'none' : '';
					if (altPane) altPane.style.display = subscribed && replace ? '' : 'none';
					if (message) message.style.display = subscribed && !replace ? '' : 'none';
				});
			}

			document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
				setHubspotField();
				fetchHubspotStatus();
			});

			document.addEventListener('gform_post_render', function(event) {
				setHubspotField();
				if (!needsIdentity()) return;
				const utk = getCookie('hubspotutk');
				if (utk) {
					const cacheKey = 'hubspot-newsletter-status-v1-' + utk;
					logDebug('Form revealed; scheduling cache clear in 3 minutes for', cacheKey);
					clearTimeout(formRefreshTimeoutId);
					formRefreshTimeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
						logDebug('Clearing cache after 3-minute delay (Gravity Form revealed)');
						localStorage.removeItem(cacheKey);
						fetchHubspotStatus(true);
					}, 3 * 60 * 1000); // 3 minutes
				} else {
					// If no cookie even after form appears, remind admin it may be blocked
					showNoCookieMessage();
				}
			});

			window.CAP_HubSpot_DebugRefetch = function() {
				logDebug('Forcing re-fetch from HubSpot API');
				fetchHubspotStatus(true);
			};

		})();
		</script>
